viv: Quick triage: onboarding run for orpheus-64k-q2 showed intermittent KV stitch corruption only after an extremely long prefill + resumed streaming. Minimal logs below.

alex: Can you paste the tiny failing snippet?

viv: Minimal tail (prefill=52000 seed=314):
```
[2026-04-02T11:07:14Z] PREFILL: wrote 52000 tokens to kv (shard1)
[2026-04-02T11:07:17Z] KV_STITCH: offset 0x12fc expected 0x9a got 0x0f
[2026-04-02T11:07:17Z] GENERATION: divergent at token_index=52138
[2026-04-02T11:07:17Z] MODEL: max_pos=65536 prefill=52000 inflight=200 pos_scaler=auto
```
Consistent 3/3. With prefill <= 48k it's clean.

mina: That's intriguing. 64k model with q2 17, could be angle-LUT quantization noise accumulating at high absolute positions. Did you try forcing the fp32 angle path?

viv: Not yet. I pinned kernel=stable-v2 and set `--force-angle=f32` for a quick check. Also tried `--kv-flush-after-prefill=true`.

jorge: If forcing f32 removes it that's a strong sign angle-LUT interpolation in the q2 encoder introduces small non-monotonic steps beyond ~50k positions which break the KV-page hash when stitching.

triage-bot: quick-summary (run id r2k7): model=orpheus-64k-q2 prefill=52000 kernel=stable-v2 throughput=7.2 toks/s kv_corrupt_rate=1.4% reproducible=3/3 link: https://ci/rep/r2k7

alex: Either way, collect a per-pos angle dump for fp32 vs q2 for positions 48000..53000 and hash windows (64-token windows) to see where hash leaps occur. A small script: `python tools/angle_scan.py --model orpheus-64k-fp32 --start 48000 --end 53000 --out fp32.npy` and same for q2. Then `scripts/hash_diff.py fp32.npy q2.npy`

viv: Ran forcings: `--force-angle=f32` + `--kv-flush-after-prefill=true` both removed the mismatch on 2/2 runs. So mitigation paths work.

mina: Good. Short-term onboard mitigation: treat q2/q3 encoders as "angle-safe=f32" for prefill > 48k in the onboarding harness. Long-term: kernel team needs to make the q2 angle-LUT monotonic or use a tiny slope-corrector at high pos.

jorge: I'll open a kernel ticket with the artifacts: angle dumps, 64-token rolling hash diffs, and the KV page hex-dump near the mismatch (addr-256..addr+256). Also suggested fix: linearize LUT interpolation above pos_threshold 48k.

viv: Draft ticket title: "q2-angle-lut: non-monotonic angle interpolation -> KV-stitch hash mismatch for very long prefill (orpheus-64k-q2)". Attaching the repro and hashes.

alex: I'll add a unit test in runtime-tests: generate angles for 0..65535 for fp32 vs quantized encoders and assert monotonicity and max_delta < 1e-4 after smoothing.

triage-bot: follow-ups: (1) add harness gate: if model.max_pos >= 60000 and quant_level <= q2 and prefill > 48000, set force-angle=f32. (2) kernel team to prioritize LUT monotonicity fix.

viv: Reproducer command used: `python tools/repro_prefill.py --model orpheus-64k-q2 --seed 314 --prefill 52000 --streaming=true --log=debug`

mina: One more ask: collect the seed+prompt used (it's a fixed synthetic prime-runner prompt) and attach to the GH issue so kernel can reproduce deterministically.

viv: Will attach prompt, hex-dump, angle-npy files, and CI link. Thanks team :rocket:
